hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let part2 be part 3 of the enemy.
Let part3 be part 5 of the enemy.
Let part4 be part 4 of the enemy.
Let v be the phase matching the current form of part under the phases list2, then the form for part under the phases list2.
If part3 is judged dead or part3 is dead and not (part3 has the DISABLE status), then count up "turnsAfterOnmyojiBDead".
If part4 is judged dead or part4 is dead and not (part4 has the DISABLE status), then count up "turnsAfterKnightBDead".
If condition flag "arise_done" is up this frame, then
  If the register's 'ariseTarget' is 4, then reset the count "turnsAfterKnightBDead".
  Otherwise, reset the count "turnsAfterOnmyojiBDead".
  Let v2 be a revive sequence {deformTag: "deformation_02", nos: [the register's 'ariseTarget']}.
  Append [{builtin: "RESET", resetChildNos: [the register's 'ariseTarget']}] to v2.
  Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: v2} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
If v is not the current form of part, then
  Part changes to form v.
  Part cancels its cast and stop.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of part.
If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_show_message_1" in the battle settings of the group of part and not the register's 'hasAlreadyDispHpRateMessage1', then
  Set the register's 'hasAlreadyDispHpRateMessage1' to true.
  Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "02", buddyId: the character DELITA}]]}.
If part is ready to act, then
  If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_show_message_2" in the battle settings of the group of part and not the register's 'hasAlreadyDispHpRateMessage2', then
    Set the register's 'hasAlreadyDispHpRateMessage2' to true.
    Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "03", buddyId: the character RAMZA}]]}.
  If the count "turnsAfterKnightBDead" is at least the numeric entry "turn_to_use_arise" in the battle settings of the group of part, then call helper with (this state, 4).
  Otherwise, if the count "turnsAfterOnmyojiBDead" is at least the numeric entry "turn_to_use_arise" in the battle settings of the group of part, then call helper with (this state, 5).
  Otherwise, part picks and uses a smart-weighted move with intro messages from list3.
If part2 is ready to act, then part2 picks and uses a smart-weighted move with intro messages from list4.
If part3 is ready to act, then part3 picks and uses a smart-weighted move with intro messages from list4.
